details:
What is Spacethropic?

Spacethropic is your first stop when planning a mission. It is your command center for selecting prospective mission sites, offering flexible, accurate, and compute efficient analog analysis and identification across both the Moon and Mars. 

You are drafting up plans for a new Lunar base located 50km North-East from Viking 1. Before you invest hundreds of millions into a space mission, you want to run some small scale experiments here on earth. Spacethropic is your solution.

The tool is simple to use:

  •  Select a candidate site you would like to explore on either the Moon or Mars using our 3D planet view. 
  •  Our Site Search Engine uses geographical features to compare the lunar site across every cell on earth!
  •  You are presented with a satellite view of high-ranking sites, allowing you to review an analysis of analogous features and how they either support or oppose the location as a candidate. 
  •  Following this initial review, you are able to use manual filters to narrow down your search. Select criteria for your mission ranging across temperature, weather conditions, surface composition, and a variety of other features. 
  •  Repeatedly refine or adjust your search to find your perfect spot. 

Once you find your perfect spot, you can export your data off-platform, allowing you to use it in any further evaluations you require!

How it works:

Our app utilizes a custom-made dataset consolidating data from X X X to split the Earth, Moon, and Mars, into H3 Resolution 7 Hexagon Cells. Earth cells are filtered to remove unusable land from the search mechanism, referring to XXXX in order to remove Ocean and Sea Cells, cells with high-human footprint, and cells with significant vegetation. 

The filtered hexagons are then enriched with data on elevation maps, soil composition, temperature spread, weather, and vegetation coverage, which enable our custom-search engine to analyze analogous features across lunar sites and candidate analogs on Earth. 

Once a user selects a prospective mission site on the 3D Planet, the app uses an acoustics inspired search algorithm to rank Earth cells on the similarity of their physical geography, noting hill shapes, dunes, troughs, and absolute elevations. 

The top X candidates are shown to the user, at which point additional filters can be applied. These filters ensure specific mission critical constraints can be applied, including surface composition requirements, site average temperatures, storms, and a variety of other selection criteria.

Filters can be iteratively applied and edited until a satisfactory site is found, at which point the site can be further analyzed and evaluated. 

Our Innovation & Challenge Fit:

Spacethropic is built on principles of reliability and accuracy. In order to maximize efficacy of our tool we tested our search algorithms across a benchmark of previously identified and used site analogs, ensuring our algorithm effectively generalizes to similar sites across all missions. Our repeated iterations allowed us to develop fully custom search algorithms and data representations which prove immensely effective at the task at hand. 

The challenge “Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars” calls for participants to identify “a compelling individual site, environment, or geophysical process to developing maps, similarity metrics, machine learning approaches, or other innovative methods for discovering and comparing planetary analogs.” Our multi-layer search algorithm and data representation methods compile into a novel framework for full-stack analog comparison, allowing experts to efficiently and scientifically evaluate and iterate on site discovery and analysis. 

Learn More at: https://spacethropic.com/paper.pdf
